<style>
iframe {
  border:none;
  width:100%;
  height:90%;
}
    .demo_text {
      font-size: 3.5em;
    }

    .demo_btn {
      background-color: #199319;
      color: white;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      font-size: 1.8em;
      font-size: 3.0em;
      width: 99%;
      border-radius: 100px;
    }

    .btn_ON {
      background-color: #cc3333;
    }

    .btn_OFF {
      background-color: #333333;
    }
    label, input, textarea {
      font-size: 1.5em;
    }
</style>
<div style="width: 100%; height: 100%;">
<button class="" id="CANVIEWER" onclick="canviewer_reset();" value="OFF">CANVIEWER: RESET</button>
<iframe id="iframe1"></iframe>
<div>
<script>
var iframe = document.getElementById("iframe1");
var uri = new URL(window.location.href);

var target_url = "http://" + uri.hostname + ":8000";
iframe.setAttribute('src', target_url);
</script>

<script>
  function get_req_v2(url) {
    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("GET", url);
    xhr.send();
    xhr.onload = () => {
      console.log("Get response", xhr.response);
    };
  }
  function canviewer_reset() {
    var hostname = window.location.hostname;
    var url = "http://" + hostname + ":9000/canviewer/RESET/";
    get_req_v2(url);
  }
</script>
